task.description:
Write test specs and integration tests for ISS-102 (tasks.claimed_by / real claim path).

Test plan from backlog:
1. Concurrent double-claim test: two workers attempt claim on same task; exactly one gets 200, other gets 409
2. Completion authorization test: only claimed_by worker (or USER-assigned assignee_ref) may complete; unauthorized worker gets 403/409

Additional coverage required:
- Happy path: claim succeeds → claimed_by set, status = IN_PROGRESS (or CLAIMED per design)
- Claim on already-claimed task → 409
- Claim on non-PENDING task → appropriate error
- Complete by claimed_by worker → succeeds
- Complete by different worker → 403/409
- Complete on task with USER-assigned assignee_ref by that user → succeeds

All integration tests must:
- Connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL
- Use per-test UUID fixtures
- Clean up after themselves
- Fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent

Deliver:
- tests/specs/ISS-102.md — spec file
- Integration test file covering all acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria: All integration tests use real PostgreSQL

result.summary: Test specs and integration tests for ISS-102 (tasks.claimed_by / real claim path). 8 test cases covering: happy path claim, concurrent double-claim, claim-on-claimed, claim-non-pending, complete-by-claimer, complete-by-other (403), USER-assigned complete-by-user, USER-assigned complete-by-other (403).
